jobs.title: Senior Manager, Business Operations
jobs.location: New York, NY · Hybrid (4 days/week in office)
jobs.why: Excellent health-tech operations fit spanning frontline operations, process scaling, dashboards/metrics, product partnership, issue triage, AI-enabled workflow automation, and cross-functional execution in home-based care.
jobs.gap: The role wants 5+ years in operations/strategy/consulting and strong zero-to-one startup experience. Emphasize healthcare operations, systems projects, workflow automation, reporting, training, and hands-on process ownership without overstating tenure.

jobs.title: Practice Operations Manager II
jobs.why: Direct healthcare-operations match involving clinical practice management, staff supervision, patient experience, workflow efficiency, compliance, and operational coordination in a major health system.
jobs.gap: The role is people-management heavy and may favor deeper ambulatory-practice leadership. Lead with healthcare operations, training, intake/workflow ownership, reporting, process improvement, and supervisory/project experience.

jobs.title: Manager, Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: New York, NY · Hybrid (3 days/week in office)
jobs.why: Strong payer/healthcare strategy-and-operations role centered on cross-functional projects, workflow design, performance metrics, implementation, executive communication, and operational problem solving.
jobs.gap: Oscar prefers direct payer/provider strategy experience and several years of enterprise project delivery. Emphasize healthcare operations, systems implementation, reporting, workflow redesign, and cross-functional coordination.

jobs.title: Manager Business Operations - Adult Reconstruction and Joint Replacement Service
jobs.why: Strong hospital operations role covering physician-practice performance, daily operations, strategic initiatives, reporting, staffing, training, and coordination across clinical and administrative teams.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for about 4+ years of progressive hospital experience and direct-report management. The salary floor is below target, so compensation should be screened early even though the range clears $100K.

jobs.title: Operations Manager - NYC
jobs.why: Healthcare-adjacent operating role with direct ownership of site operations, process execution, team leadership, member experience, and scaling operational systems in a growth-stage care company.
jobs.gap: Dental/consumer-care operations differ from ABA and health-plan workflows, and the role may emphasize frontline site management more than systems automation. Lead with healthcare service operations, training, process design, and customer/patient experience.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Business Operations
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare-technology and systems-operations alignment: provider operations, scalable workflows, automation, process improvement, cross-functional problem solving, and ownership of high-leverage operational initiatives.
jobs.gap: This is a senior stretch role and likely expects deeper startup strategy/operations tenure. Emphasize systems thinking, healthcare workflow experience, process automation, reporting, and project ownership without inflating seniority.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager (Payments and Reconciliation)
jobs.location: United States · Remote / New York, NY hybrid
jobs.why: Strong digital-health operations role involving process design, reconciliations, reporting, product/engineering partnership, workflow automation, controls, and cross-functional execution at scale.
jobs.gap: The role requires substantial payment/reconciliation and healthcare finance depth plus 6+ years. SQL is not the core ask, but the financial-operations specialization is a meaningful gap; position transferable systems, reporting, automation, and healthcare operations experience accurately.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Business Operations Oversight
jobs.location: United States · Remote · Eastern/Central time preferred
jobs.why: Healthcare payer operations role centered on scalable processes, regulatory reporting, audits, metrics, remediation, policy execution, and cross-functional operational leadership.
jobs.gap: The position expects 6+ years in healthcare operations/compliance or regulatory oversight and deeper Medicare/Medicaid/Marketplace experience. Treat as a stretch and emphasize Medicaid/healthcare operations exposure, process controls, documentation, reporting, and cross-functional implementation.

jobs.title: Client Onboarding and Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong SaaS implementation fit with client onboarding, complex software implementations, team capacity management, stakeholder communication, process standardization, and cross-functional delivery.
jobs.gap: Veterinary supply technology is outside core healthcare/ABA, and the role wants 4+ years of complex software implementation plus people management. Salary floor is below target, so confirm level/offer range early.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Business Transformation & Operations
jobs.why: Strong systems/transformation match involving operational excellence, portfolio governance, performance measurement, organizational readiness, process harmonization, and translating strategy into execution.
jobs.gap: This is a senior non-healthcare stretch role with expectations for substantial transformation leadership and team management. Lead with business analysis, workflow/process improvement, reporting, automation, and cross-functional systems delivery.
